newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Denmark-Bund 10-yr gap to change little.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Denmark-Bund 10-yr gap to change little.

text.p: The 10-year yield spread of Danish over German government bonds is expected to change little over the next 12 months, rising to an average 87 basis points by end-December 1997, compared to around 80 basis points today, a Reuter consensus poll shows.

The poll of 21 Danish and foreign analysts forecast the likely yield gap in three, six and 12 months from now between the Danish benchmark eight percent 2006 state bond and its equivalent German 10-year government paper.
The average three-month forecast for was for a 90 basis point gap, the same for six months, with the spread narrowing again by the end of the year. --Claus Mathisen, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969656
